newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish central bank raises maximum revrepo rates.
newsitem.headline: Polish central bank raises maximum revrepo rates.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland raised the maximum 14-day reverse repo rate to 22.15 percent from Wednesday's 22.10 percent and the seven-day rate to 22.10 percent from 21.63 percent on February 26, the bank said.
It drained 105 million zlotys off the market for seven days and 31 million zlotys for 14-days after investors bid to place 388 million against the central bank's 400 million zloty offer.
